# nexus nexusdconfig

Verbs: get, update

## Usage

```
nexus nexusdconfig [flags]
```

## Flags

```
  -h, --help   help for nexusdconfig
```

## Global flags

```
      --host string   target hosts: configured names, comma-separated, or all (default: NEXUS_HOST, then the default host)
      --verbose       log each request and response status to stderr
```

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`nexus nexusdconfig get`](nexus_nexusdconfig_get.md) | List nexusd's configuration keys, or with NAME, get a nexusd configuration key |
| [`nexus nexusdconfig update`](nexus_nexusdconfig_update.md) | Set nexusd configuration keys |
